"""Pure add-on candidates preserve source identities before sidecar publication."""

import copy
import importlib.util
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from mechanical_cad.assembly_model import AssemblyDocument
from mechanical_cad.model import Document

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ADDON = ROOT / "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender"
PACKAGE = "mcad_assembly_edit_test_package"
package = types.ModuleType(PACKAGE)
package.__path__ = [str(ADDON)]
sys.modules[PACKAGE] = package
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    PACKAGE + ".assembly_edit", ADDON / "assembly_edit.py"
)
edit = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = edit
spec.loader.exec_module(edit)


def document():
    return Document.from_json(
        (ROOT / "examples/viewport_rectangle.mcad.json").read_text()
    ).to_dict()


def test_user_part_becomes_grounded_definition_without_modifying_working_document():
    part = document()
    saved = copy.deepcopy(part)
    result = edit.new_from_part(part, name="User assembly")
    model = AssemblyDocument.from_dict(result)
    assert model.name == "User assembly"
    assert model.part_sources[0].document.to_dict() == part == saved
    assert len(model.instances) == len(model.parts) == 1 and not model.joints
    assert not model.verification_presets and model.active_verification_preset is None
    assert edit.canonical_digest(model.to_dict()) == model.content_hash


def test_reuse_inserts_child_and_incoming_joint_together_without_new_source():
    original = edit.new_from_part(document())
    candidate, part_id = edit.capture_definition(original, document())
    assert candidate == original
    result = edit.insert_instance(
        candidate,
        part_id,
        parent=original["grounded_instance"],
        parent_frame="origin",
        child_frame="origin",
        kind="slider",
        coordinate=20,
        limits=(0, 100),
        name="Moving block",
    )
    model = AssemblyDocument.from_dict(result)
    assert len(model.part_sources) == len(model.parts) == 1
    assert len(model.instances) == 2 and len(model.joints) == 1
    assert model.joints[0].coordinate == 20 and model.joints[0].limits == (0, 100)
    assert len(original["instances"]) == 1 and not original["joints"]


def test_changed_source_requires_explicit_all_instance_update_preserving_ids_and_frames():
    part = document()
    original = edit.new_from_part(part)
    original = edit.insert_instance(
        original,
        original["parts"][0]["id"],
        parent=original["grounded_instance"],
        parent_frame="origin",
        child_frame="origin",
        kind="fixed",
    )
    saved = copy.deepcopy(original)
    changed = copy.deepcopy(part)
    changed["parameters"]["sketch_1_width"] = 60
    with pytest.raises(edit.BridgeError, match="update available"):
        edit.capture_definition(original, changed)
    updated, affected = edit.update_source(original, changed)
    model = AssemblyDocument.from_dict(updated)
    assert affected == [i["id"] for i in original["instances"]]
    assert updated["instances"] == original["instances"] and updated["joints"] == original["joints"]
    assert updated["parts"][0]["mate_frames"] == original["parts"][0]["mate_frames"]
    assert model.parts[0].source_digest != original["parts"][0]["source_digest"]
    assert original == saved


def test_literal_frame_edit_and_working_copy_are_explicit_detached_candidates():
    original = edit.new_from_part(document())
    part_id = original["parts"][0]["id"]
    result = edit.edit_frame(
        original,
        part_id,
        frame_id="origin",
        name="Pin axis",
        placement={"xyz_mm": [3, 4, 5], "wxyz": [1, 0, 0, 0]},
    )
    model = AssemblyDocument.from_dict(result)
    assert model.parts[0].mate_frames[0].id == "origin"
    assert model.parts[0].mate_frames[0].placement.xyz_mm == (3, 4, 5)
    working = edit.working_copy(original, part_id)
    working["name"] = "Independent editor buffer"
    assert edit.working_copy(original, part_id)["name"] != working["name"]
    assert original["parts"][0]["mate_frames"][0]["placement"] == edit.origin_frame()


def paired():
    result = edit.new_from_part(document())
    return edit.insert_instance(
        result,
        result["parts"][0]["id"],
        parent=result["grounded_instance"],
        parent_frame="origin",
        child_frame="origin",
        kind="slider",
        coordinate=20,
    )


def test_named_verification_edit_keeps_pair_identity_and_invalidates_only_intent():
    original = paired()
    pair = [i["id"] for i in original["instances"]]
    kwargs = dict(
        name="Running fit",
        kind="clearance",
        pair=pair,
        minimum_mm=0.25,
        policy={
            "linear_tolerance_mm": 1e-6,
            "volume_tolerance_mm3": 1e-9,
            "linear_deflection_mm": 0.1,
        },
    )
    first = edit.edit_verification_preset(original, **kwargs)
    preset = first["verification_presets"][0]
    second = edit.edit_verification_preset(
        first, preset_id=preset["id"], **{**kwargs, "pair": pair[::-1], "minimum_mm": 0.5}
    )
    model = AssemblyDocument.from_dict(second)
    assert len(model.verification_presets[0].requirements) == 1
    assert (
        second["verification_presets"][0]["requirements"][0]["id"]
        == preset["requirements"][0]["id"]
    )
    assert (
        second["part_sources"] == original["part_sources"]
        and second["joints"] == original["joints"]
    )
    assert original["verification_presets"] == []
    cleared = edit.select_verification_preset(second, None)
    assert AssemblyDocument.from_dict(cleared).active_verification_preset is None
    assert cleared["verification_presets"] == second["verification_presets"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("active", [None, "sketch_1"])
def test_only_explicit_solid_output_can_be_captured(active):
    part = document()
    part["active_feature"] = active
    with pytest.raises(edit.BridgeError, match="solid feature"):
        edit.new_from_part(part)
